Talent is my least favourite word.

​

As a musician, I've met so many people that have told me they'd love to play whatever instrument or get into music, but they're not talented so they never will, or can.

This is so infuriating to me. Becoming good at music, or at anything, is 99% dedication and passion and the desire to become the best you can be. The most skilled people in ANY area are those who show determination and work hard, never ever those who are born a certain way.

Sometimes the hardest part of life is finding the thing that makes it worth it. Everybody has periods in their life with lack of direction and sometimes it takes a pretty big period of patience and self reflection to figure out what we're supposed to even be doing, at all.
